correctness.rationale: The axis restriction has an exact quartic factorization and yields exactly three positive axis-supported primitive two-cycles for R>2. Computing the entire 3-by-3 two-step Jacobian gives eigenvalues 5-R^2, p_R(alpha), p_R(beta); strict inequalities give the complete hyperbolic-sink criterion. Convexity of p_R gives the sharp cubic birth of a transverse -1 pocket and square-root gap. A one-step absent-species factor yields the strict q(R) positivity-accessibility separation. The standalone checker passed symbolic identities and exact rational tests; finite tests are not offered as the infinite proof. Unit-circle and equality cases are excluded from nonlinear classification.

value.rationale: A cyclic three-species map is a natural ecological and dynamical model. The simultaneous stability of three single-species period-two oscillations is a sharp multistability classification, with the nontrivial algebraic transition R^3-3R-6=0 opening a square-root-size unstable competition pocket and a reentrant real-space sink band. The exact positivity threshold q(R) distinguishes attractors with viable strictly positive basins from mathematically stable but biologically inaccessible boundary cycles. This addresses a motivated natural local classification and accessibility gap rather than a gratuitous parameter slice.
